releaseNotes: Welcome Light once again applies and verifies the dedicated builtin.welcomeLevel hardware recipe before the six-second PDO level wave begins, restoring the intended nine-segment colour ladder instead of inheriting the current Running/Alarm colour.

Welcome segment LightEffect is fixed to continuous; the 6-second setting now affects timing only. Lower-priority Running requests cannot overwrite the Welcome recipe while the startup cycle is unfinished, while Alarm priorities above PRI20 still preempt normally.
LIVE ladder vertical branch spines use a slimmer 1.8 px dashed conductor with no blur effect, while the general wire glow is reduced so vertical trunks no longer appear as thick solid columns.
V879 branch topology/coil layout, V878 Runtime-Safe Refresh isolation, V877 Background Identity true-NOOP behavior, and protected communication/PDO paths remain intact.

en: Welcome Light now verifies the dedicated builtin.welcomeLevel hardware recipe before its six-second PDO wave, restoring the intended nine-segment colour ladder rather than inheriting the current Running/Alarm colour.
Welcome segments use continuous LightEffect and PRI10 Running is suppressed only while the unfinished PRI20 Welcome owns the tower; higher-priority Alarm requests still preempt normally.
LIVE vertical branch spines are rendered with a slimmer 1.8 px dash and no blur, with a reduced general wire glow for a cleaner professional ladder appearance.
ko: Welcome Light는 6초 PDO wave 시작 전에 전용 builtin.welcomeLevel 하드웨어 recipe를 실제 적용/검증하여 현재 Running/Alarm 색상을 물려받지 않고 원래의 9개 세그먼트 컬러 래더를 복원합니다.
Welcome 세그먼트는 continuous LightEffect를 사용하며 미완료 PRI20 Welcome 동안만 PRI10 Running recipe 덮어쓰기를 막습니다. 더 높은 Alarm 우선순위는 기존처럼 정상 선점합니다.
LIVE 세로 Branch Spine은 1.8 px 점선과 no-blur로 렌더링하고 전체 wire glow도 낮춰 굵은 실선 기둥처럼 보이지 않게 수정했습니다.
ja: Welcome Light は 6 秒の PDO wave 開始前に専用 builtin.welcomeLevel hardware recipe を適用・検証し、現在の Running/Alarm 色を継承せず本来の 9 segment colour ladder を復元します。
Welcome segment は continuous LightEffect を使用し、未完了の PRI20 Welcome が tower を所有する間だけ PRI10 Running recipe の上書きを抑止します。より高い Alarm priority は従来通り preempt します。
LIVE vertical Branch Spine は 1.8 px dash / no-blur とし、全体の wire glow も弱めて太い solid column に見えないよう改善しました。
zh-CN: Welcome Light 会在 6 秒 PDO wave 开始前实际应用并验证专用 builtin.welcomeLevel 硬件 recipe，从而恢复原来的 9 段彩色阶梯，而不是继承当前 Running/Alarm 颜色。
Welcome 各段固定使用 continuous LightEffect；未完成的 PRI20 Welcome 占用信号塔时仅抑制 PRI10 Running 覆盖，更高优先级的 Alarm 仍可正常抢占。
LIVE 垂直 Branch Spine 改为 1.8 px 虚线且不使用 blur，同时降低整体 wire glow，避免显示成粗实线柱。
de: Welcome Light wendet vor der sechssekündigen PDO-Welle das dedizierte Hardware-Rezept builtin.welcomeLevel an und verifiziert es, sodass die vorgesehene 9-Segment-Farbleiter statt der aktuellen Running/Alarm-Farbe verwendet wird.

Die Welcome-Segmente verwenden einen kontinuierlichen LightEffect; PRI10 Running wird nur während des noch nicht abgeschlossenen PRI20 Welcome unterdrückt, während höhere Alarm-Prioritäten weiterhin normal übernehmen.
Vertikale LIVE Branch-Spines werden mit einer schlankeren 1,8-px-Strichlinie ohne Blur dargestellt; zusätzlich wurde der allgemeine Wire-Glow reduziert.
es: Welcome Light aplica y verifica el recipe de hardware dedicado builtin.welcomeLevel antes de iniciar la onda PDO de seis segundos, restaurando la escalera de color de 9 segmentos en lugar de heredar el color Running/Alarm actual.
Los segmentos Welcome usan LightEffect continuo; PRI10 Running solo se bloquea mientras el Welcome PRI20 no ha terminado, y las alarmas con prioridad superior siguen tomando control normalmente.
Los Branch Spine verticales LIVE se dibujan con línea discontinua de 1,8 px sin blur y con menor glow general para evitar columnas gruesas.
